race.comment: VINNY NAY (7) closed strongly behind the Burgess Queen winner Profit Motive first-up, getting back and finishing off well. Drawing out again is a query, but the best run of her debut campaign was over 1400m. Needs a touch of luck, but he looks primed for a strong showing. JUST KICK (3) contested the G1 Australasian Oaks and placed in 3YO Fillies Open company at Caulfield last preparation, while a recent Lark Hill trial win points to readiness. Looks short of her best trip, but this is the easiest race she's tackled in some time. SHENTON ROAD (15) returned with a sharp third at Ascot, beaten half a length after beginning slowly. Form out of that race has been solid and she can feature in the finish again. SUPER GOD (8) is consistent, comes off a close Northam third, and his Bunbury second two back included a held-up passage, giving him the right profile to press the main chances. NON REFLECTIVE (4) was solid on resumption when closing well and won't be far away.
